purpose: Bounded test-only independent pre-change mammalian generator; never application source or browser input
extraction: git show <commit>:<original_path>, captured as raw bytes; no import or newline normalization
hash_verification: Python hashlib.sha256 and shasum -a 256 independently agreed on each immutable Git blob
license: Covered by repository root LICENSE; copyright TR Ingram

historical_low_quality_fingerprint.meaning: Historical platform-specific material-name and position/index/instance-buffer receipt, not a universal cross-runtime oracle

runtime_contract: The test verifies these source bytes against literal hashes before import, then fingerprints baseline and candidate on the same runtime and installed Three.js. Git and Git history are not required.
